lines.t: Hello, George.
lines.zh: 你好，乔治。

lines.t: Hi, Li Rui.
lines.zh: 嗨，李瑞。

lines.t: Guess what!
lines.zh: 你猜怎么着！

lines.t: My father, Bob, and I are going to visit your hometown.
lines.zh: 我和我爸爸鲍勃要去你的家乡看看。

lines.t: Could you be our guide?
lines.zh: 你能给我们当导游吗？

lines.t: Sure!
lines.zh: 当然！

lines.t: I'd love to!
lines.zh: 我很乐意！

lines.t: Wonderful!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.t: You know, my father's last visit was about 20 years ago.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我爸爸上次去是大约20年前。

lines.t: He became a good friend of your grandfather.
lines.zh: 他和你爷爷成了好朋友。

lines.t: Grandpa will be so happy.
lines.zh: 爷爷会非常高兴的。

lines.t: They haven't seen each other for ages!
lines.zh: 他们好久没见面了！

lines.t: Yes, and my father really wants to see how the place has changed since he last visited.
lines.zh: 是啊，我爸爸很想看看自从他上次来过之后，那里发生了怎样的变化。

lines.t: What do you think of your trip so far?
lines.zh: 到目前为止，您觉得这次旅行怎么样？

lines.t: Amazing!
lines.zh: 太棒了！

lines.t: When I first visited here, it took half a day to reach the town.
lines.zh: 我第一次来这里时，到镇上要花半天时间。

lines.t: Now, with the new roads, it takes only an hour.
lines.zh: 现在有了新路，只要一个小时。

lines.t: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.t: When I was a child, the bus took nearly 40 minutes over rough roads to get to school.
lines.zh: 我小时候，公交车要在崎岖的路上开将近40分钟才能到学校。

lines.t: Now, it takes only 15 minutes.
lines.zh: 现在只要15分钟。

lines.t: Life is much easier!
lines.zh: 生活方便多了！

lines.t: Not only that. We used to have to travel far to see a doctor, but now our town has built a new hospital.
lines.zh: 不仅如此。我们过去要走很远的路去看病，现在镇上建了一所新医院。

lines.t: Great!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.t: And didn't I see a supermarket down the street?
lines.zh: 我是不是在街那头看到了一家超市？

lines.t: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.t: We didn't have any such places for shopping until 10 years ago.
lines.zh: 直到10年前，我们这里都没有这样的购物场所。

lines.t: But the biggest change is on the hills.
lines.zh: 但最大的变化在山上。

lines.t: They used to be covered with sand.
lines.zh: 那些山过去被沙子覆盖着。

lines.t: And now they have been covered with beautiful trees!
lines.zh: 现在山上长满了美丽的树木！

lines.t: I'm amazed by how green your hometown has become!
lines.zh: 你的家乡变得这么绿，真让我惊叹！

lines.t: Have you seen the corn fields outside of the town yet?
lines.zh: 你看过镇子外面的玉米地了吗？

lines.t: Yeah! They're huge!
lines.zh: 看过了！好大啊！

lines.t: There used to be sandstorms all the time, and the fields were getting smaller and smaller.
lines.zh: 以前总是刮沙尘暴，田地越来越小。

lines.t: Then, after one big sandstorm, we decided to do something.
lines.zh: 后来，在一场大沙尘暴之后，我们决定做点什么。

lines.t: What did you do?
lines.zh: 你们做了什么？

lines.t: We found a small bush.
lines.zh: 我们找到了一种小灌木。

lines.t: It had long roots that could hold the soil together.
lines.zh: 它有长长的根，能把土壤固定住。

lines.t: We began planting it in sandy areas.
lines.zh: 我们开始在沙地上种植它。

lines.t: The government provided support too.
lines.zh: 政府也提供了支持。

lines.t: Wasn't it difficult to plant so many bushes?
lines.zh: 种这么多灌木不难吗？

lines.t: Yes, it was.
lines.zh: 是很难。

lines.t: In the beginning, we worked by hand.
lines.zh: 一开始，我们靠手工干活。

lines.t: Later, we had machines to help.
lines.zh: 后来，我们有了机器帮忙。

lines.t: We have planted many bushes and trees since then.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我们种了许多灌木和树。

lines.t: There are fewer sandstorms now and the environment is getting better.
lines.zh: 现在沙尘暴少了，环境越来越好了。

lines.t: It has also improved our lives.
lines.zh: 它也改善了我们的生活。

lines.t: Everyone has become richer and happier.
lines.zh: 每个人都变得更富裕、更幸福了。

lines.t: How has life changed in your hometown over the last 20 years?
lines.zh: 在过去的20年里，你家乡的生活发生了怎样的变化？

lines.t: Oh, it has changed quite a lot!
lines.zh: 哦，变化很大！

lines.t: Many young people used to work in big cities.
lines.zh: 过去很多年轻人在大城市打工。

lines.t: Now, more of them have come back to live and work here.
lines.zh: 现在，越来越多的人回到这里生活和工作。

lines.t: Great!
lines.zh: 太好了！

lines.t: Have there been any other changes?
lines.zh: 还有其他变化吗？

lines.t: Yes, we've changed the way we farm.
lines.zh: 有，我们改变了种地的方式。

lines.t: I used to grow a few vegetables on a small farm to sell at the local market.
lines.zh: 我过去在一个小农场里种点蔬菜，拿到当地集市上卖。

lines.t: Now, I have large, high-tech greenhouses.
lines.zh: 现在，我有了大型高科技温室。

lines.t: There, I grow tons of fruit and vegetables, and sell them in large cities.
lines.zh: 我在那里种出成吨的水果和蔬菜，卖到大城市去。

lines.t: Wow, the new highway and railway must have helped a lot!
lines.zh: 哇，新修的公路和铁路一定帮了大忙！

lines.t: Oh, they have!
lines.zh: 是啊，确实是！

lines.t: Our village has become a tourist attraction.
lines.zh: 我们村已经成了一个旅游景点。

lines.t: We can now sell local products to tourists.
lines.zh: 我们现在可以把当地产品卖给游客了。

lines.t: We also sell products online to people all over China.
lines.zh: 我们还在网上把产品卖给全国各地的人。

lines.t: Have these changes greatly improved your lives?
lines.zh: 这些变化是不是大大改善了你们的生活？

lines.t: Yes! We now have new houses.
lines.zh: 是的！我们现在住上了新房子。

lines.t: And our village has just built a new hospital and a library.
lines.zh: 而且我们村刚建了一所新医院和一座图书馆。

lines.t: Wonderful!

lines.t: Together you are building a new socialist village.

lines.t: In 2017, the new 480 km Mombasa-Nairobi railway was opened.
lines.zh: 2017年，全长480千米的新蒙内铁路（蒙巴萨—内罗毕）通车了。

lines.t: Before then, the only transport links between Mombasa, Kenya's main port, and Nairobi, Kenya's capital, were rough roads and an old railway line completed in 1901.
lines.zh: 在那之前，肯尼亚的主要港口蒙巴萨和首都内罗毕之间，只有崎岖的公路和一条1901年建成的老铁路。

lines.t: The old trains were very slow.
lines.zh: 老火车非常慢。

lines.t: It took 10 hours to get to Nairobi from Mombasa by train.
lines.zh: 过去从蒙巴萨坐火车到内罗毕要10个小时。

lines.t: However, the new railway, built with China's help, has already cut the travel time between Mombasa and Nairobi to about five to six hours for passengers.
lines.zh: 然而，在中国帮助下修建的新铁路，已经把旅客往返蒙巴萨和内罗毕的时间缩短到五到六个小时左右。

lines.t: Now, more than two million people use it every year.
lines.zh: 现在，每年有两百多万人乘坐它。

lines.t: Local Kenyans have benefited a lot from the new railway.
lines.zh: 当地肯尼亚人从新铁路中受益良多。

lines.t: A government worker said, "I'm very happy with the new railway built by our Chinese friends.
lines.zh: 一位政府工作人员说：“我对中国朋友修建的新铁路非常满意。

lines.t: Many changes have taken place in the town over the last few years, and the people who live here have become rich."
lines.zh: 在过去的几年里，镇上发生了许多变化，住在这里的人也富起来了。”

lines.t: A businessman said, "My experience of using the train since 2017 has been good.
lines.zh: 一位商人说：“从2017年开始，我乘坐这趟火车的体验一直很好。

lines.t: It is very convenient and doesn't cost much money.
lines.zh: 这非常方便，而且花不了多少钱。

lines.t: I am able to get to places on time and make business deals with ease."
lines.zh: 我能准时到达目的地，轻松地谈成生意。”

lines.t: The railway has also made the transport of food easier.
lines.zh: 这条铁路也让食物运输变得更容易了。

lines.t: "It used to take hundreds of lorries to carry food between the two cities,
lines.zh: “过去在两座城市之间运送食物要用几百辆卡车，

lines.t: but now it takes only two or three trains," said a supermarket manager.
lines.zh: 而现在只要两三列火车。”一位超市经理说。

lines.t: As a result, people now have more fresh food to eat.
lines.zh: 因此，人们现在能吃到更多新鲜的食物。

lines.t: Although China and Kenya are far away from each other, the railway shows how different countries can work together to build a better world.
lines.zh: 虽然中国和肯尼亚相距遥远，但这条铁路展示了不同国家怎样携手建设一个更美好的世界。

lines.t: who do you admire the most?
lines.zh: 你们最钦佩谁？

lines.t: Yes, Yaming?
lines.zh: 好，亚明？

lines.t: I really admire Yuan Longping.
lines.zh: 我非常钦佩袁隆平。

lines.t: That's great!

lines.t: Yuan Longping also trained many people to do research on farming in China and other parts of the world.
lines.zh: 袁隆平还在中国和世界其他地方培训了许多人从事农业研究。

lines.t: Who else inspires you?

lines.t: Yes, Peter?

lines.t: I admire Michael Faraday very much.
lines.zh: 我非常钦佩迈克尔·法拉第。

lines.t: It was amazing that he did scientific research in physics and chemistry even though he didn't receive a formal education.
lines.zh: 令人惊叹的是，尽管没有受过正规教育，他仍在物理和化学领域进行了科学研究。

lines.t: Yes, Michael Faraday dropped out of school at an early age, but he found every chance to study and became a great scientist.
lines.zh: 是的，迈克尔·法拉第很小就辍学了，但他抓住一切机会学习，成了一位伟大的科学家。

lines.t: Thanks!
lines.zh: 谢谢！

lines.t: Do you know,

lines.t: Fu Xing?

lines.t: Yes, Ms Gao.
lines.zh: 知道，高老师。

lines.t: My father loves history.
lines.zh: 我爸爸热爱历史。

lines.t: He admires Sima Qian.
lines.zh: 他钦佩司马迁。

lines.t: Ah yes,
lines.zh: 啊，对，

lines.t: the writer of the book Shiji (Records of the Grand Historian).
lines.zh: 就是《史记》的作者。

lines.t: He also played a big part in reviewing the Chinese calendar at that time.
lines.zh: 他还在修订当时的中国历法中发挥了重要作用。

lines.t: Oh, I didn't know that.
lines.zh: 哦，这个我不知道。

lines.t: But I know he was the kind of person who never gave up.
lines.zh: 但我知道他是那种从不放弃的人。

lines.t: Right.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.t: It's always important to keep going in life.
lines.zh: 在生活中坚持下去总是很重要的。

lines.t: What about you, Emma?
lines.zh: 埃玛，你呢？

lines.t: My grandma told me about Marie Curie, a great scientist.
lines.zh: 我奶奶给我讲过伟大的科学家玛丽·居里。

lines.t: She made many important discoveries in physics and chemistry.
lines.zh: 她在物理和化学领域有许多重要发现。

lines.t: Yes. I admire Madame Curie too!
lines.zh: 是的。我也很钦佩居里夫人！

lines.t: It was difficult for women to do that kind of work back in those days. And she won two Nobel Prizes!
lines.zh: 在那个年代，女性做那种工作很难。而且她获得了两次诺贝尔奖！

lines.zh: 对我来说，一定是著名的英国工程师伊桑巴德·布鲁内尔。

lines.zh: 他修建了英国第一批铁路，还有许多其他重要的东西，比如桥梁、轮船和隧道。

lines.t: Oh, I see.

lines.t: How about you, Mum?

lines.t: Well, I am really inspired by Florence Nightingale.
lines.zh: 嗯，弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔真的很激励我。

lines.t: She created modern nursing.
lines.zh: 她开创了现代护理事业。

lines.t: It was wonderful of her to help us understand the need for cleaner hospitals to stop the spread of diseases.
lines.zh: 她帮助我们认识到医院需要更干净才能阻止疾病传播，真了不起。

lines.t: The Inspiring Seed Scientist On 25 September 2017, the scientific world was shaken by the news that Chinese professor Zhong Yang had died in a car accident.
lines.zh: 激励人心的种子科学家 2017年9月25日，中国教授钟扬在一场车祸中不幸去世的消息震惊了科学界。

lines.t: The well-respected biologist had spent his whole life researching plants and seeds.
lines.zh: 这位备受尊敬的生物学家一生都在研究植物和种子。

lines.t: Over the years, he collected many important seeds for China's seed banks.
lines.zh: 多年来，他为中国的种子库收集了许多重要的种子。

lines.t: These special banks protect all kinds of plant seeds, including the ones we need for food, and they make sure that important plants do not disappear from the world forever.
lines.zh: 这些特殊的种子库保护着各种植物种子，包括我们赖以为食的那些，确保重要的植物不会从世界上永远消失。

lines.t: Zhong Yang was born in 1964.
lines.zh: 钟扬出生于1964年。

lines.t: When he was young, he showed a deep love for and a curiosity about the things he studied.
lines.zh: 年轻时，他就对所学的东西表现出深深的热爱和好奇。

lines.t: He was an excellent student, entering university at the early age of 15.
lines.zh: 他是一名优秀的学生，15岁就上了大学。

lines.t: There, he studied radio engineering and later became interested in plants.
lines.zh: 他在那里学习无线电工程，后来对植物产生了兴趣。

lines.t: The research and study of plants, especially the seeds, became the focus of his life after he became a professor at Fudan University.
lines.zh: 成为复旦大学的教授后，研究植物，尤其是种子，成了他生活的重心。

lines.t: It is important for seed banks to include many different kinds of seeds.
lines.zh: 种子库收藏许多不同种类的种子很重要。

lines.t: When Zhong Yang discovered that there was not enough research on the seeds from Xizang, he went there to collect seeds himself.
lines.zh: 当钟扬发现对西藏种子的研究不够时，他亲自去那里采集种子。

lines.t: In 2001, he began his travels across Xizang.
lines.zh: 2001年，他开始了穿越西藏的旅程。

lines.t: It was very difficult for him to brave the cold weather and great heights.
lines.zh: 对他来说，顶着严寒、登上高处非常艰难。

lines.t: He sometimes fell sick, but he always continued with his work.
lines.zh: 他有时会生病，但总是坚持工作。

lines.t: Zhong Yang knew it was better to include more people when doing important work.
lines.zh: 钟扬知道，做重要的工作时最好让更多的人参与进来。

lines.t: He began a programme to find and train local students in field research to become scientists.
lines.zh: 他启动了一个项目，寻找当地学生并训练他们进行野外研究，让他们成为科学家。

lines.t: Together, he and his team collected more than 40 million seeds from over 1,000 types of plants.
lines.zh: 他和他的团队一起，从一千多种植物中收集了四千多万粒种子。

lines.t: Their hard work provided the world with lots of new information about the plants in China.
lines.zh: 他们的辛勤工作为世界提供了大量关于中国植物的新信息。

lines.t: Zhong Yang left behind more than just a huge collection of seeds.
lines.zh: 钟扬留下的不只是大量的种子收藏。

lines.t: His love for his job and research lives on in his students.
lines.zh: 他对工作和研究的热爱在他的学生身上延续。

lines.t: He once said, "My students will continue on the road of scientific exploration, and the seeds we have collected may grow hundreds of years from now."

lines.t: How to Become a Successful Learner
lines.zh: 怎样成为成功的学习者

lines.t: Everyone has the ability to learn.
lines.zh: 每个人都有学习的能力。

lines.t: Experts on the science of learning will tell you that anyone can become a successful learner.
lines.zh: 研究学习科学的专家会告诉你，任何人都能成为成功的学习者。

lines.t: However, many students do not realize this, and they have trouble learning.
lines.zh: 然而，许多学生没有意识到这一点，他们在学习上遇到困难。

lines.t: Studies show that the first key to becoming a successful learner is to have a growth mindset.
lines.zh: 研究表明，成为成功学习者的第一个关键是拥有成长型思维。

lines.t: This means, in part, believing in yourself.
lines.zh: 这在某种程度上意味着相信你自己。

lines.t: It also means setting goals, taking action, and meeting challenges.
lines.zh: 它还意味着设定目标、采取行动、迎接挑战。

lines.t: People with a growth mindset see mistakes as chances for learning, as they teach us how to improve.
lines.zh: 拥有成长型思维的人把错误看作学习的机会，因为错误教会我们如何进步。

lines.t: Research also shows that practice is important for learning.
lines.zh: 研究还表明，练习对学习很重要。

lines.t: The more we practise, the better we learn.

lines.t: We learn best by practising new and difficult things.

lines.t: Sometimes it is also important to get guidance from a teacher or a coach.

lines.t: They can show us the right way to practise and give us important feedback and advice.
lines.zh: 他们能告诉我们正确的练习方法，并给我们重要的反馈和建议。

lines.t: In addition, studies show that students learn more when they hang out with other students who are serious about study.
lines.zh: 此外，研究表明，和认真学习的同学在一起时，学生能学到更多。

lines.t: First, by being together, students can easily learn from each other.
lines.zh: 首先，在一起时，学生们可以很容易地互相学习。

lines.t: Second, students are challenged to do better by each other.
lines.zh: 其次，学生们会互相激励，争取做得更好。

lines.t: This has been proven to encourage learner growth.
lines.zh: 这已被证明能促进学习者的成长。

lines.t: Successful learners also use the best learning materials they can find.
lines.zh: 成功的学习者也会使用他们能找到的最好的学习材料。

lines.t: In the 21st century, this means using new technology and resources, not just textbooks.
lines.zh: 在21世纪，这意味着要使用新技术和新资源，而不只是课本。

lines.t: Since there are so many learning materials on the Internet, it is important to think carefully and choose wisely what and how you study.
lines.zh: 由于网上的学习材料太多，仔细思考、明智地选择学什么和怎么学很重要。

lines.t: Take advantage of the best tools and resources to learn wisely and efficiently.
lines.zh: 利用最好的工具和资源，明智而高效地学习。

lines.t: Finally, successful learners see learning as part of daily life.
lines.zh: 最后，成功的学习者把学习看作日常生活的一部分。

lines.t: It is something they will do even after they leave school, and even when they are old.
lines.zh: 即使离开学校，甚至到了老年，他们也会坚持学习。

lines.t: As you continue on your learning journey, you should try to walk at your own speed and enjoy the trip.
lines.zh: 在继续学习之旅时，你应该按自己的节奏前行，享受这段旅程。

lines.t: Never lose heart.
lines.zh: 永远不要灰心。

lines.t: The road ahead of you may be long and may have many mountains and valleys, but it also has great treasure.
lines.zh: 你前面的路可能很长，可能有许多高山和深谷，但也有巨大的宝藏。

lines.t: You will find more joy in living a life with learning!

lines.t: How to Boost Your Memory
lines.zh: 怎样增强你的记忆力

lines.t: Would you like to improve your memory?
lines.zh: 你想提高你的记忆力吗？

lines.t: To start with, it is important to understand how memory works.
lines.zh: 首先，了解记忆是怎样运作的很重要。

lines.t: There are two main kinds of memory: short-term memory and long-term memory.
lines.zh: 记忆主要有两种：短期记忆和长期记忆。

lines.t: Short-term memory helps you remember things that you may only need for a short time, like phone numbers when you need to make a phone call.
lines.zh: 短期记忆帮助你记住只需要短时间记住的东西，比如打电话时要拨的号码。

lines.t: Long-term memory is the ability to remember things for days, years, or even a lifetime.
lines.zh: 长期记忆是把东西记住几天、几年甚至一辈子的能力。

lines.t: So the real question is: How do you make sure what you learn enters your long-term memory?
lines.zh: 所以真正的问题是：你怎样确保学到的东西进入长期记忆？

lines.t: By using some clever memory techniques and leading a healthy life, you will see some great results.
lines.zh: 运用一些巧妙的记忆技巧，过健康的生活，你就会看到很好的效果。

lines.t: Let's take a look.
lines.zh: 我们来看一看。

lines.t: First, pay attention.
lines.zh: 第一，集中注意力。

lines.t: However, you might fail to remember all the details.
lines.zh: 然而，你可能记不住所有的细节。

lines.t: So, try taking notes by writing down key points.
lines.zh: 所以，试着把要点写下来做笔记。

lines.t: After all, it is easier to remember a summary than every word in a passage.
lines.zh: 毕竟，记住一段话的概要比记住其中每个字容易。

lines.t: Second, use it or lose it.
lines.zh: 第二，不用就会忘。

lines.t: The more you review what you learn, the more likely you will remember it.
lines.zh: 你复习学过的东西越多，就越可能记住它。

lines.t: However, you should not wear out your brain.
lines.zh: 然而，你不应该让大脑过度疲劳。

lines.t: Try studying for 40 minutes, and then take a break.
lines.zh: 试着学习40分钟，然后休息一下。

lines.t: You can also review information by discussing it with others or by teaching others.
lines.zh: 你也可以通过和别人讨论或教别人来复习。

lines.t: A third way is to make use of your senses.
lines.zh: 第三个方法是利用你的感官。

lines.t: Create images by using tables, graphs, and mind maps to organize information.
lines.zh: 用表格、图表和思维导图来整理信息，形成图像。

lines.t: You can also create a story with information and view it in your mind like a film.
lines.zh: 你也可以用信息编一个故事，像看电影一样在脑海里回放。

lines.t: In addition, make use of your other senses.
lines.zh: 此外，还要利用你的其他感官。

lines.t: For example, listening to recorded information can be very effective.
lines.zh: 例如，听录下来的信息会非常有效。

lines.t: Last but not least, boost your memory by staying healthy.
lines.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，保持健康来增强记忆力。

lines.t: Sleep well.
lines.zh: 睡好觉。

lines.t: While you sleep, your brain organizes your memories.
lines.zh: 在你睡觉的时候，你的大脑会整理你的记忆。

lines.t: Bad sleep makes it harder for new information to enter your long-term memory.
lines.zh: 睡眠不好会让新信息更难进入长期记忆。

lines.t: Eat well.
lines.zh: 吃好饭。

lines.t: Your brain needs food like an engine needs fuel.
lines.zh: 你的大脑需要食物，就像发动机需要燃料一样。

lines.t: Healthy food and drink will help your brain work much better.
lines.zh: 健康的饮食会帮助你的大脑运转得更好。

lines.t: Exercise.
lines.zh: 锻炼身体。

lines.t: A healthy and active body boosts both your memory and your mind.
lines.zh: 健康而有活力的身体能增强你的记忆力和思维能力。

lines.t: Exercise can also reduce stress and anxiety.
lines.zh: 锻炼也能减轻压力和焦虑。

lines.t: Many more memory techniques can be found in books or online.
lines.zh: 在书上或网上还能找到更多记忆技巧。

lines.t: Try some different methods to see which ones work best for you.
lines.zh: 试试不同的方法，看看哪些对你最有效。

lines.t: You are sure to improve your memory.
lines.zh: 你一定能提高记忆力。

lines.t: An Invention That Changed the World
lines.zh: 一项改变世界的发明

lines.t: Can you imagine a world without books, newspapers, or magazines?
lines.zh: 你能想象一个没有书、报纸和杂志的世界吗？

lines.t: All of these things depend on one invention—papermaking.
lines.zh: 所有这些东西都依赖于一项发明——造纸术。

lines.t: It, more than any other invention, was responsible for the rapid spread of information that shaped our modern world.
lines.zh: 它比其他任何发明都更能促成信息的迅速传播，塑造了我们的现代世界。

lines.t: In ancient China, many different materials were used to write on, such as animal bones, bronze ware, stones, wood, bamboo, and even silk.
lines.zh: 在古代中国，人们在许多不同的材料上写字，比如兽骨、青铜器、石头、木头、竹子，甚至丝绸。

lines.t: In the Western Han Dynasty, there was also a very early form of paper made from jute—a fibre that comes from plants.
lines.zh: 西汉时期，还有一种非常早期的纸，是用黄麻做的——黄麻是一种来自植物的纤维。

lines.t: However, all of these materials were either difficult to use and store, or very expensive.
lines.zh: 然而，所有这些材料要么难以使用和保存，要么非常昂贵。

lines.t: As the head officer of the palace workshop for the emperor in the Eastern Han Dynasty, Cai Lun became interested in trying to solve the problem.
lines.zh: 东汉时期，蔡伦作为为皇帝掌管宫廷作坊的长官，开始想办法解决这个问题。

lines.t: Different methods for creating something to write on were tried, but none were ideal.
lines.zh: 人们尝试了各种方法来制造可以写字的东西，但都不理想。

lines.t: In his time, some kinds of bark—the outer part of trees—were used to make clothes.
lines.zh: 在他那个时代，有些树皮——也就是树的外层——被用来做衣服。

lines.t: From past experiences, Cai Lun got the idea that bark, certain plants, and old clothes could be used to make a special material suitable to write on.
lines.zh: 根据以往的经验，蔡伦想到，树皮、某些植物和旧衣服可以用来制作一种适合写字的特殊材料。

lines.t: In the first step of Cai Lun's experiment, all the ingredients were mixed and boiled in water.
lines.zh: 在蔡伦实验的第一步，所有原料被混合在一起放进水里煮。

lines.t: Then, this material was beaten, cut up, and mixed with water again.
lines.zh: 然后，把这些材料捶打、切碎，再和水混合。

lines.t: Next, the liquid was poured over a bamboo screen, leaving just the fibre.
lines.zh: 接着，把液体倒在竹帘上，只留下纤维。

lines.t: Finally, this fibre was dried and pressed to form paper.
lines.zh: 最后，把这些纤维晾干、压平，就成了纸。

lines.t: To everyone's surprise, this paper was soft, light, easy to make and use, and most importantly, cheap.
lines.zh: 让所有人惊讶的是，这种纸又软又轻，容易制作和使用，最重要的是很便宜。

lines.t: In 105 CE, Cai Lun showed his creation to the emperor.
lines.zh: 公元105年，蔡伦把他的发明献给了皇帝。

lines.t: The emperor was very pleased and praised Cai Lun for his great work.
lines.zh: 皇帝非常高兴，称赞了蔡伦的伟大成就。

lines.t: Later on, the papermaking technique not only speeded up the development of Chinese culture but also changed civilizations around the world.
lines.zh: 后来，造纸术不仅加快了中华文化的发展，也改变了世界各地的文明。

lines.t: It first spread to China's neighbouring countries and finally reached Europe through Arab countries in the 12th century.
lines.zh: 它先传到中国的邻国，最后在12世纪经阿拉伯国家传到欧洲。

lines.t: When the use of paper and printing came together in later centuries, it led to a rapid increase in the number of books.
lines.zh: 在后来的几个世纪里，纸和印刷术结合起来，使书的数量迅速增加。

lines.t: This resulted in a new birth of knowledge, creating the world we have today.
lines.zh: 这带来了知识的新生，创造了我们今天的世界。

lines.t: China's new space programme was made public today.
lines.zh: 中国新的航天计划今天公布了。

lines.t: Exploration of the planet Mars and the moon will be continued.
lines.zh: 对火星和月球的探索将继续进行。

lines.t: China's Zhurong rover successfully landed on Mars in 2021, and it is hoped that a manned mission to the moon will follow around 2030.
lines.zh: 中国的祝融号火星车于2021年成功登陆火星，人们希望2030年前后能实现载人登月。

lines.t: China has announced that more astronauts will be sent to the Tiangong space station.
lines.zh: 中国宣布，将有更多航天员被送往天宫空间站。

lines.t: Since the space station was completed in 2022, it has been used to do research on biology, medicine, and materials.
lines.zh: 自2022年建成以来，空间站一直被用于开展生物、医学和材料方面的研究。

lines.t: It will also continue its cooperation with Germany, Italy, and Russia on scientific research.
lines.zh: 它还将继续与德国、意大利和俄罗斯开展科学研究合作。

lines.t: News report 3

lines.t: According to Chinese space scientists, Chang'e-6 collected 1,935.3 grams of precious soil samples from the far side of the moon.
lines.zh: 据中国航天科学家介绍，嫦娥六号从月球背面采集了1935.3克珍贵的月壤样品。

lines.t: These samples will be stored and studied by scientists.
lines.zh: 这些样品将由科学家保存和研究。

lines.t: It is believed that our understanding of the moon and the universe will be greatly improved.
lines.zh: 人们相信，我们对月球和宇宙的了解将大大提高。

lines.t: Let's wait and see what will be discovered in the future.
lines.zh: 我们拭目以待，看看将来会发现什么。

lines.zh: 我可以轻松地转身！

lines.t: You see, I can move everywhere by just pushing against the wall!
lines.zh: 你看，我只要推一下墙，就能移动到任何地方！

lines.t: Ms Wang, what does Earth look like from the space station?
lines.zh: 王老师，从空间站看地球是什么样子的？

lines.t: It looks like a huge shining ball.
lines.zh: 它看起来像一个巨大的发光的球。

lines.t: It's really beautiful.
lines.zh: 真的很美。

lines.t: Ms Wang, I want to know how you eat up there.
lines.zh: 王老师，我想知道你们在上面怎么吃饭。

lines.t: Nice question.
lines.zh: 好问题。

lines.t: Well, all our food is prepared on Earth and kept in bags.
lines.zh: 嗯，我们所有的食物都是在地球上准备好、装在袋子里的。

lines.t: We have over 120 dishes to choose from.
lines.zh: 我们有120多种菜可以选择。

lines.t: What's difficult about living in space?
lines.zh: 在太空生活有什么困难吗？

lines.t: Well, it's a little hard to fall asleep.
lines.zh: 嗯，入睡有点难。

lines.t: We have to be tied down so we don't fly away!
lines.zh: 我们得被绑住，才不会飘走！

lines.t: Do you get bored?
lines.zh: 你们会觉得无聊吗？

lines.t: Will you be visited by other astronauts?
lines.zh: 会有其他航天员来看你们吗？

lines.t: It's never boring in space.
lines.zh: 在太空从来不会无聊。

lines.t: Actually, two astronauts will arrive next month.
lines.zh: 实际上，下个月就有两名航天员要来。

lines.t: It's very exciting.
lines.zh: 非常令人兴奋。

lines.t: Our question today is: Why do we explore space?
lines.zh: 我们今天的问题是：我们为什么要探索太空？

lines.t: Let's talk to space scientist Dr Yang. Welcome, Dr Yang! Thank you very much. Well, there are three good reasons to explore space. First, to improve our knowledge of Earth and its place in the universe. Could you explain that a bit more?
lines.zh: 让我们和航天科学家杨博士聊一聊。欢迎您，杨博士！非常感谢。嗯，探索太空有三个很好的理由。第一，增进我们对地球及其在宇宙中位置的了解。您能再解释一下吗？

lines.t: Sure. The study of other planets helps us better understand Earth's geology, history, and relationship with other planets. Oh, right.
lines.zh: 当然。研究其他星球有助于我们更好地了解地球的地质、历史以及它与其他星球的关系。哦，明白了。

lines.t: Second, technology developed for space can benefit us here on Earth. Could you give our listeners an example?
lines.zh: 第二，为太空研发的技术能让我们在地球上受益。您能给听众举个例子吗？

lines.t: Of course. Some satellites, for example, help us deal with problems caused by climate change. Yes, that's very useful.
lines.zh: 当然。例如，有些卫星帮助我们应对气候变化带来的问题。是的，那非常有用。

lines.t: And the third reason?
lines.zh: 那第三个理由呢？

lines.t: Well, at some point in the far future, we may find new resources in outer space. It might sound crazy, but our Earth may run out of resources. In that case, a new home for us human beings will be needed. Wow, interesting! Maybe Mars will be turned into our new home in the future.
lines.zh: 嗯，在遥远的将来，我们也许会在外太空找到新资源。这听起来可能很疯狂，但我们的地球可能会耗尽资源。那样的话，我们人类就需要一个新家园。哇，真有意思！也许将来火星会变成我们的新家园。

lines.t: Where would you find an article like this?
lines.zh: 你会在哪里看到这样的文章？

lines.t: Reaching for the stars.
lines.zh: 伸手摘星。

lines.t: Since the beginning of human history, people have looked up at the stars and wondered what they were like.
lines.zh: 自人类历史开始以来，人们就仰望星空，想知道星星是什么样子的。

lines.t: Many ancient cultures believed that these points of light were from gods or other mysterious worlds.
lines.zh: 许多古代文化认为，这些光点来自神灵或其他神秘的世界。

lines.t: However, as science and technology developed, we learnt the truth about stars.
lines.zh: 然而，随着科学技术的发展，我们知道了星星的真相。

lines.t: They are real places like our own sun, and they are farther away than anyone imagined.
lines.zh: 它们是像我们的太阳一样真实存在的地方，而且比任何人想象的都要遥远。

lines.t: This raises the question: Can we visit the stars one day?
lines.zh: 这就引出了一个问题：我们有一天能去星星那里吗？

lines.t: The man-made object which has travelled farthest from Earth is Voyager 1.
lines.zh: 离地球最远的人造物体是“旅行者1号”。

lines.t: This spacecraft was launched in 1977.
lines.zh: 这艘宇宙飞船于1977年发射。

lines.t: In case Voyager 1 is found by alien life, a special record with sounds and pictures from Earth is carried on board.
lines.zh: 为防“旅行者1号”被外星生命发现，它上面载有一张记录着地球声音和图片的特殊唱片。

lines.t: It shows who we are and where we are from.
lines.zh: 它展示了我们是谁、来自哪里。

lines.t: By 2025, Voyager 1 was over 25 billion kilometres from Earth, but that is still a long way from Earth's second-closest star, Proxima Centauri.
lines.zh: 到2025年，“旅行者1号”距离地球已超过250亿千米，但那里离地球第二近的恒星比邻星仍然很遥远。

lines.t: That star is 4.2 light years away—about 40 trillion kilometres!
lines.zh: 那颗恒星在4.2光年之外——大约40万亿千米！

lines.t: The challenge of visiting the stars gets even bigger for space flights with humans.
lines.zh: 对载人航天来说，飞往恒星的挑战更大。

lines.t: The farthest that any human has travelled in space is only about 400,000 kilometres, to the far side of the moon.
lines.zh: 人类在太空中到过的最远距离只有大约40万千米，那就是月球背面。

lines.t: Time is a big problem.
lines.zh: 时间是个大问题。

lines.t: At present, even a journey to the planet Mars will take around six to nine months.
lines.zh: 目前，即使是去火星，也要花六到九个月左右。

lines.t: What will the astronauts eat and drink during this period?
lines.zh: 在这段时间里，航天员吃什么、喝什么？

lines.t: And how about their health and safety?
lines.zh: 他们的健康和安全又怎么办？

lines.t: These problems grow when we talk about visiting another star.
lines.zh: 说到飞往另一颗恒星，这些问题就更大了。

lines.t: It might take hundreds of thousands of years to get there!
lines.zh: 到那里可能需要几十万年！

lines.t: Scientists, however, believe that visiting the stars is not a completely wild dream.
lines.zh: 然而，科学家们认为，飞往恒星并不完全是异想天开。

lines.t: One idea is to have the astronauts sleep during their journey, like some animals do in winter.
lines.zh: 一个想法是让航天员在旅途中睡觉，就像一些动物冬眠那样。

lines.t: Another is to develop much faster spacecraft.
lines.zh: 另一个办法是研制快得多的宇宙飞船。

lines.t: While this is not possible right now, with nations and scientists cooperating with one another, there is hope that the necessary technology will be developed.
lines.zh: 虽然现在还做不到，但随着各国和科学家们相互合作，必要的技术有望被研发出来。

lines.t: Humans have photographed other galaxies, set foot on the moon, and even successfully landed rovers on Mars.
lines.zh: 人类已经拍摄到其他星系，登上了月球，甚至成功让探测车登陆火星。

lines.t: It seems likely that one day we will reach the stars.
lines.zh: 看起来我们有一天很可能会到达星星那里。

lines.t: A Great Inspiration

lines.t: When the great composer Robert Schumann first heard a work which was written by young Chopin, he said, "Hats off, gentlemen! A genius!" Frédéric
lines.zh: 伟大的作曲家罗伯特·舒曼第一次听到年轻的肖邦写的作品时说：“先生们，脱帽致敬吧！这是一位天才！”弗雷德里克·

lines.t: Chopin (1810–1849) is considered one of the greatest musicians in history.
lines.zh: 肖邦（1810—1849）被认为是历史上最伟大的音乐家之一。

lines.t: During his short lifetime, he was celebrated as one of the world's greatest pianists— even though he only gave around 30 concerts!
lines.zh: 在短暂的一生中，他被誉为世界上最伟大的钢琴家之一——尽管他只举办过大约30场音乐会！

lines.t: He was also a gifted composer who left behind more than 200 musical works.
lines.zh: 他还是一位有天赋的作曲家，留下了200多部音乐作品。

lines.t: Chopin was born in a village in Poland.
lines.zh: 肖邦出生在波兰的一个村庄。

lines.t: He didn't attend music school until he was 16, but soon outdid his teachers.
lines.zh: 他16岁才上音乐学校，但很快就超过了他的老师。

lines.t: His parents sent him to Vienna in 1829 to widen his musical experience.
lines.zh: 1829年，他的父母送他去维也纳开阔音乐眼界。

lines.t: By 1832, he had made his way to Paris, the city that he would call home for the rest of his life.
lines.zh: 到1832年，他来到了巴黎，此后一生都把那座城市当作家。

lines.t: Chopin was not only a great pianist, but also a respected piano teacher.
lines.zh: 肖邦不仅是一位伟大的钢琴家，还是一位受人尊敬的钢琴老师。

lines.t: He often told his students, "Put all your soul into it! Play the way you feel!"
lines.zh: 他常常对学生说：“把你全部的情感投入进去！按照你的感受去弹！”

lines.t: This is advice that is still followed by musicians today.
lines.zh: 这条建议至今仍被音乐家们遵循。

lines.t: Polish folk music was a kind of music that some people looked down on at the time—it
lines.zh: 波兰民间音乐在当时是一种被一些人看不起的音乐——

lines.t: time—it was seen as too simple and common. But it became an important characteristic of Chopin's music.
lines.zh: ——它被认为太简单、太普通。但它成了肖邦音乐的一个重要特点。

lines.t: His use of Polish folk music caused people to see it as a valuable art form.
lines.zh: 他对波兰民间音乐的运用让人们把它看作一种有价值的艺术形式。

lines.t: His music also helped build a nation which was divided up by other countries.
lines.zh: 他的音乐还帮助建设了一个被其他国家瓜分的国家。

lines.t: By using Polish folk music, Chopin seemed to be saying to the world, "We are our own country with our own culture! We are our own people!"
lines.zh: 通过运用波兰民间音乐，肖邦似乎在向世界宣告：“我们是一个有自己文化的国家！我们是独立的民族！”

lines.t: Chopin's music encouraged his people and helped them keep going through years of difficulty.
lines.zh: 肖邦的音乐鼓舞了他的人民，帮助他们度过了多年的艰难岁月。

lines.t: Today, the Polish people proudly think of Poland as the country of Chopin.
lines.zh: 如今，波兰人民自豪地把波兰看作肖邦之国。

lines.t: When Chopin died from ill health at 39, thousands of people travelled from faraway countries to attend his funeral.
lines.zh: 肖邦39岁因病去世时，成千上万的人从遥远的国家赶来参加他的葬礼。

lines.t: Today, people around the world still listen to his moving and often sad music.
lines.zh: 如今，世界各地的人们仍在聆听他那动人而常常带着忧伤的音乐。

lines.t: It is studied in music schools, played by pianists, heard in films and on TV, and loved by listeners young and old.
lines.zh: 音乐学校研究它，钢琴家演奏它，电影和电视里能听到它，男女老少的听众都喜爱它。

lines.t: Good morning, everyone!

lines.t: Today, I'd like to talk about my favourite sports event.
lines.zh: 今天，我想谈谈我最喜欢的体育盛会。

lines.t: Actually, when I used the word "event", I meant two events: the 2008 Summer Olympics and the 2022 Winter Olympics.
lines.zh: 其实，我用“盛会”这个词，指的是两届盛会：2008年夏季奥运会和2022年冬季奥运会。

lines.t: They were held in Beijing—the first city ever to host both the Summer and the Winter Olympics.
lines.zh: 它们都在北京举办——北京是有史以来第一座同时举办过夏季和冬季奥运会的城市。

lines.t: The most recent was the 2022 Winter Olympics. A total of nearly 2,900 athletes attended and competed in 109 events in seven Olympic winter sports.
lines.zh: 最近的一次是2022年冬奥会。共有近2900名运动员参加了7个冬季运动大项、109个小项的比赛。

lines.t: There were many exciting moments.
lines.zh: 有许多激动人心的时刻。

lines.t: Nearly the whole world watched the fantastic figure skating and ski jumping competitions.
lines.zh: 几乎全世界都观看了精彩的花样滑冰和跳台滑雪比赛。

lines.t: I watched the freestyle skiing, and like everyone else,
lines.zh: 我看了自由式滑雪，和其他人一样，

lines.t: I fell in love with those brave and talented athletes.
lines.zh: 我爱上了那些勇敢而有天赋的运动员。

lines.t: I also became a huge fan of the mascot, Bing Dwen Dwen.
lines.zh: 我还成了吉祥物冰墩墩的超级粉丝。

lines.t: And we shall not forget the amazing achievements in the 2008 Summer Olympics.
lines.zh: 我们也不应忘记2008年夏季奥运会上取得的惊人成就。

lines.t: I watched in wonder as Usain Bolt smiled his way across the finish line in the 100 metres, setting a new world record.
lines.zh: 我惊奇地看着尤塞恩·博尔特面带微笑冲过百米终点线，创造了新的世界纪录。

lines.t: Then I watched the drama of the shooting event.
lines.zh: 然后我观看了扣人心弦的射击比赛。

lines.t: Du Li won her second Olympic gold medal, after the first one in 2004.
lines.zh: 杜丽在2004年首次夺冠后，又获得了她的第二枚奥运金牌。

lines.t: Both were dramatic come-from-behind victories.
lines.zh: 两场都是激动人心的逆转胜利。

lines.t: Hosting two Olympics brought challenges but also opportunities to Beijing.
lines.zh: 举办两届奥运会给北京带来了挑战，也带来了机遇。

lines.t: Both Games showed China's success in its reform and opening-up on the world stage.
lines.zh: 这两届奥运会都在世界舞台上展示了中国改革开放的成就。

lines.t: China's great achievements have gained worldwide attention.
lines.zh: 中国的伟大成就赢得了全世界的关注。

lines.t: In both events, many volunteers and citizens helped out.
lines.zh: 在这两次盛会中，许多志愿者和市民都出了力。

lines.t: They worked with pride to make sure that people from around the world had a pleasant stay.
lines.zh: 他们满怀自豪地工作，确保来自世界各地的人们过得愉快。

lines.t: Events like the Olympic Games build bridges between countries and form friendships between people.
lines.zh: 像奥运会这样的盛会在国家之间架起桥梁，在人们之间建立友谊。

lines.t: The purpose of the Olympics is to build relationships between people, to celebrate the Olympic spirit, and to bring people together for peace and harmony.
lines.zh: 奥运会的目的是在人与人之间建立联系，弘扬奥林匹克精神，把人们团结在一起，共享和平与和谐。

lines.t: This is shown in both the motto of the 2008 Olympics, "One World, One Dream", and the motto of the 2022 Olympics, "Together for a Shared Future".
lines.zh: 这体现在2008年奥运会的口号“同一个世界，同一个梦想”和2022年冬奥会的口号“一起向未来”中。

lines.t: These mottos touch my heart quite deeply, as I'm sure they touch yours.
lines.zh: 这些口号深深打动了我，我相信也打动了你们。

lines.t: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家聆听。
